newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Five Star Beer Co Q1 profit 1.74 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China's Five Star Beer Co Q1 profit 1.74 mln yuan.

text.p: Sino-U.S. joint venture Beijing Asia Shuanghesheng Five Star Beer Co Ltd made a profit of 1.74 million yuan in the first quarter, compared with a loss of 1.05 million yuan in the year-ago period, a company official said on Monday.

Sales of the beer, which since 1957 has been the official beer at China's state banquets, reached 25,970 tonnes in the first three months of this year, up 11.5 percent from the same period in 1996, the official said.
Output and sales this year were expected to increase 20 percent compared with last year, he said.
In 1996, the company reported losses of 15 million yuan, compared with 60 million yuan in losses for the previous year, he said.
Established in January, 1995, Beijing Asia Shuanghesheng Five Star Beer Co Ltd is a joint venture between Beijing's Shuanghesheng and ASIMCO (Asian Strategic Investments Corp) of the United States.
ASIMCO is a Beijing-based but U.S.-managed direct investment company that has 17 joint ventures in China, 13 of them in auto parts and components.
